pageIntro: Connect an Identity Provider and choose who can sign in to Jellyfin.
administratorGroupValidation: Enter an Administrator group before disabling local passwords for all Jellyfin Users.
provisioningEmailHelp: Requires currently verified email. Existing users are never renamed.
usernameMatchingHelp: Only use this when Provider usernames match Jellyfin usernames.
enabledHelp: Allow eligible users to sign in through the Provider.
publicUrlHelp: Leave empty to use the browser address.
clientIdHelp: The client ID registered with the provider.
clientSecretHelp: The secret for this client ID.
requireVerifiedEmailHelp: Applies to sign-in and linking. Email matching always requires verification.
provisioningUsernameHelp: Falls back to verified email. Existing users are never renamed.
automaticLinkingUsername: Match Provider username to Jellyfin username
automaticLinkingHelp: Links to Jellyfin Users who already exist. New Jellyfin Users can still be created.
userGroupHelp: Exact Provider group names, separated by commas.
administratorGroupHelp: Comma-separated groups. Administrator status updates at sign-in.
groupClaimHelp: Top-level string or string array. Default: groups.
additionalScopesHelp: Space-separated. openid, email and profile are always requested.
passwordLoginModeHelp: Applied to all Jellyfin Users on save.
synchronizeProfileImagesHelp: Use the Provider's picture claim at sign-in.
rpInitiatedLogoutHelp: Also end the Provider session when signing out of Jellyfin.
groupValidation: Enter Allowed groups, Administrator groups, or both.
httpsUrlValidation: Enter the HTTPS base address, for example https://jellyfin.example.com.
localPasswordWarning: Local password sign-in will be disabled for {0}. Verify OIDC sign-in is working before saving.
linkError: We couldn't link your Provider. Please try again.
signInError: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
logoutError: Signed out of this browser. The server could not confirm sign-out.
linkPasswordHelp: Linking will disable password sign-in for this Jellyfin User.
linkConflict: This identity cannot be linked. Ask an administrator to check existing Identity Links.
adminEmailHelp: Email must be verified at sign-in. Matching ignores case.
adminSubjectHelp: The Provider's stable user ID, not a session ID. Must match exactly.
adminUsernameHelp: Uses the configured Username claim. Matching ignores case.
adminApprovalHelp: Links this user on their next matching sign-in. Approval stays active until used or cancelled.
adminBlocked: Automatic relinking is disabled after unlinking.
adminDisabled: OIDC is unavailable. You can still unlink or retry sign-out.
adminPartial: Some OIDC sessions could not be signed out. Retry sign-out.
adminConflict: The link or approval conflicts. Refresh and try again.
adminError: Unable to complete this operation. Refresh and try again.
adminUnlinkWarning: Unlink {0}? This ends tracked OIDC sessions and disables automatic relinking. Other sessions stay active.
adminPasswordAllowed: Password sign-in stays available if you know the password.
adminPasswordRestored: Password sign-in will be restored. No password is created.
adminPasswordDisabled: Password sign-in stays disabled. Relinking may be needed for access.
adminSelfWarning: If you used OIDC, you’ll be signed out. Make sure you can sign in again.
adminSoleWarning: This is the only administrator. Recovery may require host access.
